STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_01800_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_01800_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_01800 (
  clk,
  rst,
  din,
  mvalid,
  ready,
  done,
  tx_enable,
  svalid,
  sready,
  sdata,
  ciphered,
  odat,
  idat,
  key,
  load
);

input wire clk;
input wire rst;
input wire [7 : 0] din;
input wire mvalid;
output wire ready;
input wire done;
output wire tx_enable;
output wire svalid;
input wire sready;
output wire [7 : 0] sdata;
input wire [63 : 0] ciphered;
input wire [63 : 0] odat;
output reg [63 : 0] idat;
output reg [79 : 0] key;
output reg load;

// Internal variables
reg [7:0] shift_reg;
reg tx_enable_reg;
reg svalid_reg;
reg ready_reg;

// Update shift register and generate output signals
always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
        shift_reg <= 8'b0;
        tx_enable_reg <= 0;
        svalid_reg <= 0;
        ready_reg <= 0;
        idat <= 64'b0;
        key <= 80'b0;
        load <= 0;
    end else begin
        if (mvalid && sready) begin
            shift_reg <= din;
            tx_enable_reg <= 1;
            svalid_reg <= 1;
            ready_reg <= 1;
            idat <= ciphered;
            key <= {odat[63:0], 16'hAAAA}; // Example logic for key generation
            load <= 1;
        end else begin
            tx_enable_reg <= 0;
            svalid_reg <= 0;
            ready_reg <= 0;
            load <= 0;
        end
    end
end

assign tx_enable = tx_enable_reg;
assign svalid = svalid_reg;
assign ready = ready_reg;
assign sdata = shift_reg;

endmodule
